definitions: The act of repairing or restoring something to working order.
A device or attachment used to fasten one thing to another.
The dishonest manipulation of the outcome of a race or contest.
The process of making a photographic image permanent.
examples: The fixing of the broken pipe took hours.
Check the wall fixings before mounting the shelf.
Allegations of match fixing surfaced after the game.
The chemical fixing of the film is the final step.
